lines.en: In around one billion years, the inevitable heat death of the planet, brought on by the slowly intensifying nuclear fusion of the sun, will leave oceans dry and the ground beneath our feet scorched.
In around two billion, Google tells me that something called the “magnetic dynamo” will cease. And that the death of the magnetosphere will cause Earth’s atmospheric gases to bleed out into space.
In about four billion, we’ll basically be Venus.

All life will be extinct and our home will become the birthplace of Destiny 30’s Vault of Glass 2, a brand new raid in a franchise that will have long outlived its already unnecessary lifespan by then.
Who knows what happens after that?
Maybe the sun expands and consumes our planet as a whole?
Maybe there’s some other secret sun lying in wait for its older brother’s life to start winding down so it can swoop in and assassinate it like in Crusader Kings 3 or some other grand strategy game.
Or maybe God will save us all!
Not just those who believe, but all of us because that is what a god should do.
We still have plenty of time, though. Maybe. Possibly?
Is the sun still growing while we bask in its seemingly perpetual rays? The ones that blanket us in fire and heat and cause cancer to those who are too stubborn to ever wear sunscreen.
I bet you’re wearing a hat right now. For reasons no more logical than that I think it would be kind of cool for you to be wearing one.
You know what? Go put on a hat if you’re not already hatted up and we’ll pick things up from the next text box.
Great. Now that your gear is properly equipped, take the hat off. You look stupid. I was wrong.
Besides, where we’re going, it’d do little to protect you from the heat anyway. In fact, even sunscreen won’t help! So now’s the perfect time to be stubborn if any!
You’re being watched again.
: Later, Io! I’ll tell Miss Watabe you can’t come to kyūdō today because of stupid brain stuff! See you back at the dorms!
: Uta, I have to go clean the bathhouse. My brain is weirdly fine right now.
: I know! I just don’t think that excuse would work as well and it’s my job as your best friend to make up for all of your selfish yet lovable flaws through lying! Love you!
: Aww, I love you too. Now, please excuse me while I get miles away from the creature standing beside you.
: The what?
: Hello.
: Jesus! How long have you been standing there? And since when are you basically a ninja?
: I realized at a young age that stealth would be a very important trait if I ever wanted to spy on my classmates outside of their dorm rooms.
: A worthy time investment, I must say. I’ve learned so much about all of you by listening in on your nightly routines over the last several years.
: You masturbate a lot, by the way. More than even I do.
: Wha- no?! Why do you know that thing that most definitely isn’t true?!
: Are you free right now, by any chance?
: After that opener?! I don’t think so, lady! And I don’t know what you think you have planned for me, but it definitely isn’t happening because I’m definitely not interested!
: It doesn’t involve masturbation. That was just an ice breaker I employed to try and start this conversation on equal grounds we can both relate to.
: It seems my attempt has failed based on your expression, though. Should I go fuck myself now? Figuratively, of course. I have trouble reaching climax in the bathroom here.
: What do you want with me, Nodoka? It’s not like you to come up to me after school. And I have club anyway, so...
: I’d ask if there’s a better time. I just know there isn’t one because today is Thursday and I know that you immediately begin working on yourself the moment you get home from school.
: Though, I suppose I could just talk to you while you’re doing that if it makes your schedule any easier to-
: IO WORKS LATE ON THURSDAYS! AND STOP SPYING ON ME! THERE’S NO WAY MY MASTURBATION SCHEDULE IS THAT CONSISTENT!
: Understood. I suppose I’ll just leave you alone regarding all things related to the irregular flow of time then.
: Oh. Is that what this is about? Because Sensei told me you knew stuff too. I just figured you were up to more Nodoka things based on all the stealth and masturbation stuff.
: A reasonable assumption. But yes, I’d like to speak with you about your take on all of this seeing as you and I are the newest members of what the rest are calling an “apocalypse squad.”
: No more weird stuff then? Cause I don’t wanna call out of club if there’s going to be weird stuff.

: Is the fact that we’re perpetually trapped inside a looping high school life not weird to you? Because I sort of agree. I just don’t want to agree to that in case our outlooks differ in this regard.
: I meant like sex-weird.
: That’s like 33%% of my personality. You’d have me suppress that much? What if I can’t think properly?
: Who’s second place after me? Assuming I’m in first.
: I can show you the entire log if you’re truly interested. I have the dates, times, and session duration listed for every instance I’ve encountered.
: No! Bad Uta! This is forbidden information! You will not stoop to her level regardless of your insatiable perversions!
: Besides, you’re only in first place on the second floor. Perhaps you can take some solace in knowing that you’d be second overall if we combined both?
: Wait, I do it more than Kirin?! And Molly?! There’s no way I do it more than Molly! I can hear those sex games she plays through the wall every day!
: I know you can. Those games aren’t the only sound audible through the walls.
: AAAAAAHHHH! FINE! I’LL COME WITH YOU! JUST STOP EMBARRASSING ME IN FRONT OF MY LOCKER! I DON’T KNOW HOW OLD IT IS AND THERE’S A CHANCE IT MIGHT BE SENTIENT!
: So...what are we doing here exactly?
: Right now? Stopping for a drink. Are you thirsty? This could be a great opportunity for our first indirect kiss.
: I’m good, thanks. It just seems sort of like you made a beeline for this very specific alleyway the moment we left school, so I’m not sure if I’m about to be murdered or not.
: I’m a pacifist. Something would really need to break me if I were going to resort to physical violence. And I’m nowhere close to snapping yet.
: Who knows given what we’ve learned, though? Because, on one hand, I’m glad to know that time isn’t running out...
: But, on the other, I understand that when things feel too good to be true, it’s because they are. And that there must be some sort of catch to all of this that I’m not quite grasping yet.
: I’m honestly surprised you haven’t figured this all out already. It isn’t often you’re actually challenged by anything, yeah?

: Likewise, you seem quite calm and composed compared to what I’d expect out of a rambunctious and peculiar thing like you. Are you not at all scared to find out that our lives are essentially artificial?
: Artificial? That’s not how I look at it at all.
: How do you look at it then?
: Batshit crazy.
: I see.
: But also kind of...relieving in a way?
: All this time, I’ve felt like there’s been some sort of clock ticking. Thousands of clocks, even. And each one was for a different thing I couldn’t bring myself to do anything about.
: Not in like one of those...executive dysfunction ways or something like that, though. It’s more just me being afraid of ever upsetting anyone and then...upsetting myself in the process.
: But now...it’s like all of those clocks have stopped all of a sudden. And there’s no pressure to do something right away anymore because I know we’re not going anywhere.

: That’s probably why I seem so calm. I feel calm. Like, don’t get me wrong, this shit’s still Gwen Stefani as hell but, like...okay? I’m down for an infinite loop of hanging out with my friends. Who wouldn’t be?
: There’s no curiosity then? Of why this is happening or the key to escaping it? If we can even escape it at all.
: There’s curiosity, sure. It’s a weird thing and I think it’d be cool to know how the weird thing works. But is it enough to, like...do something about it? Hell no.
: I mean, what could someone like me even do to begin with? You and Makoto are the smart ones. I’m just the flirty maid girl who spends Thursdays disappointing her parents.

: So, at the present time, you’re appreciative of this development. Do you worry at all how that may affect the others’ perception of you? Because Akira and Ayane seem rather anxious to escape this all.
: Of course I worry. I always worry about what other people think of me. It’s, like...baked into who I am and I don’t think it’s possible for me to change that.
: But at the same time...maybe this could be a chance to work on that?

: Maybe, if I can take my time...I can make a newer...even more desirable version of Uta. One that’s actually brave and assertive and actually does something instead of just watching from the sidelines.
: I’d be stupid not to jump on a chance like that, wouldn’t I?
: Why do you even want to know, though? Like why do this alone instead of with the rest of the squad? It’s not really just because you and me are the newbies, is it?
: Of course not. I’m sure you know well enough by now that I’m not one to act without reason.
: Something many fail to understand, though, is that I do these things not out of malice, but necessity.
: Yet, alas — I’ve found myself questioning necessity as a whole lately.
: I wonder...how much suffering in the hands of others would you accept to enrich your own life, Uta? Because, at the moment, it appears that you wouldn’t accept any at all.
: But this better version of yourself that you want to build would surely need to accept some, would she not? So how much is acceptable?
: And would you call me a bad girl if I watched those closest to me suffer without so much as lending a hand?
: Can I be brutally honest for a second, Nodoka?
: Of course. You’ve seen firsthand that if anyone can take a beating, it’s me.
: Great! Well, in that case, you’re already a bad girl. So bad, in fact, that I find myself silently wishing harm upon you every time I see your face.

: Do I want to feel that way? Of course not. But I do! Because you’re an unfiltered, insensitive, selfish bitch who is chased by a cloud of misery raining sadness upon everyone else you associate with.
: And the only reason I can smile right now despite being drenched in your presence is because I have so much practice pretending to be happy when I’m not! I don’t like you. You’re a very bad girl.
: I agree.
: Well, don’t because it undercuts everything I just said and makes me look like the bad guy instead for pointing it out!
: This is about Io, isn’t it? You’ve held this in for quite a long time.
: If you haven’t noticed, I’ve been doing a pretty great job of never having a full-length conversation with you!

: Then you had to go and ruin it all by dragging me into some random alley and asking me if I’m thirsty and also knowing my masturbation schedule! You’re so bad and you only get away with it because you’re hot!
: I’m sorry for what happened back then. And I’m sorry now for drenching you in secondhand sorrow.
: Stop apologizing and just let me be mean for another minute! I never get to do that and you gave me permission to be brutally honest!
: Apologies. By all means, go right ahead.
: Great! Well, now I can’t think of anything so just say whatever you were about to say and I’ll try to think of more stuff about you to complain about!
: All I’m really saying is that this recent revelation has somehow brought me closer to earth than I’ve ever been before.
: And that I’m surprising even myself by how little I want to know the answers I’ve been searching for my whole life now that they’re finally within my reach.
: Could this be the fear of finality, perhaps? The fear of being wrong? Or do I, too, just wish to become someone better than who I am now?

: I admire you. Being able to identify your own flaws. Being able to change at will. So much so that I’d wish to trade my knowledge for that if said knowledge didn’t prevent me from actually doing so.
: Uhh...th...thank you?
: Have you thought up any more mean things to say to me yet?
: You...uh...
: You smell too much like coffee sometimes.
: I did not realize this was a character flaw. Does everyone think that?

: I don’t know what everyone thinks, Nodoka. I can wager a guess but, as someone who spends every waking moment trying to uncover our stories like we’re characters in some book, I think you’d do a better job than me at it.
: Do you think anyone will ever understand me? The way I do them.
: What, by going up to some podium and revealing your deepest traumas to everyone over a PA system?
: I’m not sure I have any trauma, to be honest. I’m not really sure what you’d say.
: Well, lucky you. Maybe you’d be a little more careful if you had something you were ashamed of. Or hurt by. Or something that scared you. But you don’t.

: And I don’t want to say you never will because I hope you do. I just...you piss me off. And it pisses me off even more that you pulled me out here without ever even acknowledging that I might feel that way.
: It just felt like an unrelated topic to me. I didn’t expect the conversation to take a turn in this direction when I confronted you about time loops.
: I don’t care about time loops. Especially when the only reason I’m probably aware of them in the first place is because of a ghost. Life doesn’t make sense. Just leave Io alone, okay?
: A ghost?
: Just a weird dream I had when I zoned out at the maid cafe. I’d say it’s probably nothing but who the heck even knows at this point?
: She didn’t have blue eyes, did she? A flower in her hair?
: No, weirder. It was Ami’s mom.
: What?...
: Don’t tell her I said anything, though. I’m giving you one chance to kind of maybe partially redeem yourself here. And things are already weird enough with me and Ami as-is.
: You saw her?...The Girl Who Cannot Breathe?
: That’s...a weird way to refer to a dead person. But yeah? Or at least someone who claimed to be Ami’s mom. But it’s not like I ever saw her in real life and-
: This changes things.
: I need to go think.
: What?! You’re just leaving?! You’re not even going to walk me back to the dorm?!
: I might hate you, but I’m still a cute girl, you know! We need to move in pairs! There are all sorts of weird people on the loose out there!
: So he can see her...and she can see her...but I can’t see her?
: Does this mean...
: Kyoko...
: Nodoka! Mumbling to yourself in public is going to attract the exact people I just warned you about!
In ten billion years, there will be nothing left.
But I will still be here.
And you...
You will have wished you had believed.
